text:
nora: Quick ping pushed a compact relnotes draft (PR #498) for the small rollout next week. Focus: release notes + migration steps for SDK v0.10.0 and link fixes. Please scan for broken snippets and any customer-facing phrasing.

vik: scanning now. Noticed the Python snippet uses `openai.Client()` pattern from old SDK. Should be `redwood.Client()` in our examples now. I'll paste a corrected snippet in a sec.

liam: Heads up: the migration guide needs a short section about model pinning behavior change. We should add an example config and callout: "existing pinned routes may fallback to variant if exact commit missing".

nora: Good catch. Keep it brief: one example JSON + one sentence explaining behavior. We don't want to over-explain in relnotes.

vik: Fixed Python snippet (minimal):
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=... )
resp = client.generate("hello")
print(resp.output_text)
```
Also removed a stray trailing comment in the JS snippet.

liam: For changelog bullet, propose: "SDK: v0.10.0 - updated client constructors, improved streaming stability, and clarified model pinning semantics (see migration guide)." Keep it short.

nora: Slight reword: change "clarified" -> "changed" so it's obvious it's behavioural; add link to migration guide (kb-6122).

liam: Updated. Also adding an examples subsection for the CLI command to smoke-test a release: `redwoodctl test --sample short-chat --wait 30s`. We'll put that in PR comments.

qa-bot: Running docs-lint and snippet-run on branch refs/heads/release/relnotes-498...
qa-bot: docs-lint: 1 warning (terminology: "fallback routing" flagged).
qa-bot: snippet-run: Python example OK, JS example fails (console.log undefined in example).

vik: I fixed the JS console.log issue (was referencing `response.data.text` vs `response.output`). Pushed.

nora: Thanks. Two public-facing notes we must include: 1) Known issue: embedding streaming may truncate at token boundary on some quantized models (workaround: use `streaming.fallback=true`). 2) Rollout window: June 7-8; full rollout contingent on telemetry.

liam: We should avoid exposing internal flags. Use public toggle name `streaming.legacy_fallback=true`. Also add brief "What to watch" list: increased small-batch latencies, a small rt spike during migration.

nora: Good. Keep "What to watch" to two bullets.

docs-bot: linkcheck started for PR #498.
docs-bot: linkcheck: found 1 external 404 -> replaced with webarchive link by vik. All links now 200.

qa-bot: final: snippet-run: all examples pass locally; docs-lint: fixed vocabulary nit. Ready for editorial pass.

nora: Plan: merge after editorial sign-off tomorrow morning. If any customers hit regressions during canary, we'll rollback using the deployment tag. Leave any last edits in the PR comments. :party_parrot:

vik: I'll add the CLI smoke test and a tiny grep command to validate expected keys: `redwoodctl test ... | jq -r .status`.

liam: I'll update the relnotes to reference KB-6122 and the short migration example.

nora: Awesome. Thanks team.
